title: Vegetable Bhuna Stir Fry
description: A Japanese-inspired stir-fry made with Vegeta and bhuna sauce, featuring an assortment of colorful vegetables.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add sliced bell pepper, carrots, and snow peas. Cook for 4-5 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Add Vegeta, bhuna sauce, soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce is bubbly and the vegetables are coated.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped green onions if desired.
